The number of photons emitted by a monochromatic (single frequency) infrared range finder of power 1 mW and wavelength of 1000 nm, in 0.1 second is x 1013. The value of x is _____________. (Nearest integer)

(h = 6.63 1034 Js, c = 3.00 108 ms1)
en.explanation:
Energy emitted in 0.1 sec.

= 0.1 sec.

= 104 J

If 'n' photons of = 1000 nm are emitted, then 104 = n



n = 5.02 1014 = 50.2 1013

50 (nearest integer)
